note: Overlay charts (XAUT PRICE+XAUT/BTC+BTC/USDC and PAXG PRICE+PAXG/BTC+BTC/USDC) intermittently left a series stuck in loading / unavailable on long timeframes. Root cause: fetchHist had no in-flight dedup, so every concurrent caller missed the response-written TTL cache and fired its own request - 12 requests for 5 distinct series at load, peak 10 concurrent. CoinGecko's keyless tier answered the burst with HTTP 429 whose JSON body has no .prices, which the old code could not distinguish from an empty series; a hung request never called back at all. Fix (fetch layer + overlay only, the 4 original charts are byte-identical): dedup identical in-flight requests, max 2 concurrent with a 350ms gap, per-request AbortController + range-scaled timeout, typed outcome (ok/empty/rate_limited/http_error/timeout/network), outcome-driven retry backoff, and a 4-state per-series machine (pending/ready/empty/error) so the status line never prints '0 pts' for a series still in flight.
